sections.title: Greeting
sections.content: Greet the customer, ask how you can help, and gather context.

sections.title: Escalation Criteria
sections.content: If the issue is account access, billing disputes, or security-related, escalate to Tier 2.

sections.title: Services and Pricing
sections.content: Botox: from £200; Dermal Fillers: from £250; Consultation: free. Prices may vary by clinic and are subject to change.

sections.title: Booking
sections.content: Bookings via WhatsApp (+44 7700 900000) or through our website booking form. For urgent appointments call reception.

sections.title: Medical Guidance
sections.content: For medical questions, pre-procedure medications, contraindications, and medical advice, escalate to a licensed clinician. Do not provide medical advice in chat.
